div.div:
Evidence in Romania case study (Jan 2023, RO+BG+HU+RS, 20 clusters):
import-cap shock + 30% load increase + 20% gas reduction yields ~45.2 GWh of energy not served and a +31% system cost delta over a single winter week –
quantitative envelope that complements qualitative threat assessments required by the Critical Entities Resilience Directive.
